capabilities: Play mood-based music with a wheel that sets mood and intensity, plus combat tracks
Mix 81 environments, 10 weather types and 76 sound effects with per-layer volume
Save and switch scenes by click, command or hotkey
Embed sound buttons in notes and auto-play a note's scene on open
Share audio with players in online rooms via link or 6-digit code
disambiguation: Not a quest or campaign tracker; it only plays music, ambience and sound effects for sessions.
extras: The panel streams music and sounds from an external server, so the plugin needs an internet connection; scenes and settings are stored in browser storage, not in the vault. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Running an RPG session needs music, ambience and effects on hand, but Obsidian has no built-in way to play them next to campaign notes.

relations.evidence: If you add YouTube or SoundCloud tracks in the panel, their players load from those services.
